spec.title: Annual cyber-awareness training completion is established
spec.statement: The supplied Alder Forge legal-entity scope has a current, attributable annual training report showing completion for every member of the supplied required-population basis.
spec.rationale: This Objective evaluates supplied aggregate population and completion facts only. It does not establish the complete real-world employee or contractor population, person-level membership, or training-record sufficiency beyond the bounded report.
